sql:

WITH yc_pid AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PID FROM Person WHERE Name IN ('Yash Chopra', ' Yash Chopra')
),
yc_films AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MID FROM M_Director WHERE PID IN (SELECT PID FROM yc_pid)
),
yc_actors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.PID

    JOIN yc_films yf ON mc.MID = yf.MID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yc_actors

WITH yc_pid AS (

),
yc_actors AS (

actor_dir_counts AS (

        mc.PID,

    WHERE mc.PID IN (SELECT PID FROM yc_actors)
    GROUP BY mc.PID, md.PID

yc_counts AS (
    SELECT PID, film_count as yc_count
    FROM actor_dir_counts
    WHERE director_pid IN (SELECT DISTINCT PID FROM yc_pid)
),
max_other_counts AS (

    FROM actor_dir_counts
    WHERE director_pid NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT PID FROM yc_pid)
